description: x.md is a read-only service that turns public X content into Markdown or JSON, including posts, threads, profiles, followers, following, and search results. It is designed for direct fetching by scripts and AI agents without requiring X credentials.
summary: mdfromx.com exposes two public integration surfaces: a read-only HTTP API on https://mdfromx.com/api/v1 documented by https://mdfromx.com/openapi.json, and a public MCP server at https://mdfromx.com/mcp over Streamable HTTP; both are usable without credentials.
